verbatim: Not sure it is even "adopting" when you realize that it is just the way the network will behave.
context: Said in the Claude3 session about Birth at the network's edges (claude3/outbox 0082, 0085; record claude3/work/principal_inputs/PRINCIPAL_INPUT_DARK_ENERGY_V001.txt).
decision: Birth at the network's edges, where newborn sites can give birth, is native UNT behaviour. It is not a rule change to adopt. The restriction "Birth only at original sites" in native_full_h.py is a limit of the finite implementation.
guards: Classified native by the principal's definition, not derived. Results that relied on Births running out must be re-read, interior versus frontier.
